draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) reported that salience pre-filtering reduced the share of news summaries containing an unsupported entity by 31% relative to an unfiltered summarizer, across three news summarization benchmarks.
rationale: P1 describes the filtering method only; it reports no 31% figure, no unsupported-entity reduction, and no three-benchmark evaluation. The 31% figure appears only in the Methods summary as an unverified attribution ("often credited"), not in the cited passage. No evidence supports the claim.

judgement.strongest_supported: Varga & Sandoval (2021) described a salience pre-filtering method (sentence scoring, threshold 0.35, applied identically at training and inference), but the supplied passage reports no hallucination-reduction figure and no benchmark count.
